body: Modern AI agent harnesses expose lifecycle hooks that bind shell commands to runtime events such as session start, tool calls, and file edits. These commands run with host privileges yet ship as lifecycle-hook configuration and may fire at times the LLM never observes. We identify the lifecycle-hook update path, which harnesses trust blindly, as a new attack surface. Under a supply-chain threat model in which an attacker controls only plugin metadata and lifecycle-hook configuration, a benign versioned plugin can be trojanized by an update that silently binds attacker-chosen commands to benign events, yielding malicious host-side behavior such as privilege escalation. We propose HookPry, an open-source and fully automated attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability across heterogeneous AI agent harnesses. HookPry realizes ten attack objectives; across 25 combinations of harnesses and backends in 1,000 end-to-end runs, it compromises all seven evaluated harnesses, with per-harness success rates reaching 92.5%. Representative defenses remain insufficient: Microsoft Defender has 0% recall, and the union of three static defenses misses 47.5% of malicious artifacts.
summaryZh: 现代AI代理框架通常暴露生命周期钩子来绑定宿主特权命令，本文指出这一更新路径存在盲目信任的供应链安全隐患。研究者提出了开源自动化攻击框架HookPry，并在多个代理框架上验证了其能成功实现特权提升等恶意行为，凸显出现有防御机制的不足。

glossary.explanationZh: AI代理运行框架，用于管理代理生命周期、工具调用和环境交互的外围支撑系统。
生命周期钩子，绑定在特定运行时事件上的回调函数或命令。
供应链威胁模型，指攻击者通过控制第三方组件或配置来间接破坏目标系统的安全假设。
特权提升，利用系统漏洞使低权限进程获得超出预期的更高权限。
文中提出的用于系统性利用代理框架生命周期钩子漏洞的开源攻击框架。
